title: forge — regale

translations.translation: 稳步前进, 铸造, 伪造

sentences.sentence: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
sentences.translation: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

sentences.translation: 假护照

sentences.sentence: The election results were nullified because of voter fraud.
sentences.translation: 由于选票造假，选举结果被宣布无效。

sentences.translation: 她受到了自己家庭传统的影响。

sentences.sentence: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
sentences.translation: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

sentences.sentence: The allure and charm of Paris excite all who visit there.
sentences.translation: 巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。

sentences.sentence: The allure and charm of Paris captivate all who visit there.
sentences.translation: 巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。

translations.translation: 洗擦, 擦净, 使(气体)净化, 擦洗

sentences.sentence: He scrubbed the dirt off his boots.
sentences.translation: 他把靴子上的脏土擦掉。

sentences.sentence: The table needs to be scrubbed clean .
sentences.translation: 这桌子要擦干净。

sentences.sentence: She leant forward to peruse the document more closely.
sentences.translation: 她俯身向前，更仔细地读那份文件。

translations.translation: 下沉, 沉淀, 平息, 减退, 衰减

sentences.sentence: After the heavy rains, part of the road subsided.
sentences.translation: 大雨过后，部分路面塌陷了。

sentences.sentence: The law would preempt stronger local rules.
sentences.translation: 该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。

sentences.sentence: "the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
sentences.translation: “适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

translations.translation: 闲荡, 虚度, 徘徊

sentences.sentence: Five or six teenagers were loitering in front of the newsagent’s.
sentences.translation: 五六个青少年在报摊前面游荡。

sentences.sentence: Did you hear his frenzied tattle?
sentences.translation: 你听见这疯狂的闲谈了吗？

sentences.sentence: But does tittle-tattle really help attract more friends?
sentences.translation: 但闲聊真的能吸引来更多的朋友吗？

sentences.sentence: His conduct did not comport with his high position.
sentences.translation: 他的所作所为与他的高级职务不相称。

sentences.sentence: Milton claims that epic poetry is the highest ambition for a poet and then he goes on to explain how it is that the epic poet should comport himself.
sentences.translation: 弥尔顿声称史诗就是诗人最高的理想抱负,然后他又解释到,史诗诗人该怎样表现自己。

sentences.sentence: The answer lies, yet again, in the interplay of population and technology.
sentences.translation: 原因又一次在于人口和科技的相互影响。

sentences.sentence: The tension and interplay between the situation and its negation, produce constantly new and emergent forms of social existence.
sentences.translation: 这些情形和其否定之间的张力和相互影响一直在产出崭新的和突现的社会存在形式。

sentences.sentence: To date, most research into the interplay of exercise and anxiety has focused on the actions of various neurotransmitters or chemical messengers within the brain, like serotonin and dopamine.
sentences.translation: 迄今为止，大多数有关锻炼和焦虑的相互影响的研究都集中在大脑内的各种神经递质或化学信使，如血清素、多巴胺上。

sentences.sentence: Sing a descant on a main tune or melody.
sentences.translation: 以主调或悦耳的音调唱着评论。

sentences.sentence: Police are sifting through the evidence.
sentences.translation: 警方在筛查证据。

sentences.sentence: Schmidt continued to expound his views on economics and politics.
sentences.translation: 施密特继续阐释他关于经济与政治的观点。

sentences.sentence: Disclosure: This reporter also lives in New Haven and has heard Chua regale friends with parenting stories.
sentences.translation: 揭秘：记者也住在纽海文，曾经听过蔡在餐桌上分享育儿故事。

sentences.sentence: Here you can still enjoy Chinese and Western buffet in the fresh morning, taste tea in the vernal afternoon and regale special beefsteak in the charming night.
sentences.translation: 在这里，您还可以在晨光中享用中西自助餐，在和熙的午后，品尝下午茶，在摇曳烛光中享用特色牛排。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 323 单元

forge
音标：英 /fɔːdʒ/  美 /fɔrdʒ/
v. 稳步前进, 铸造, 伪造
短语：forge ahead — 继续进行，取得进展
短语：forge piece — 锻件
短语：forge press — 锻压机
短语：forge iron — 搅炼生铁；锻铁
例句：Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。
例句：a forged passport
假护照

nullify
音标：英 /'nʌlɪfaɪ/  美 /'nʌlɪ'fai/
v. 无效
例句：The election results were nullified because of voter fraud.
由于选票造假，选举结果被宣布无效。

materialize
音标：英 /mə'tiəriəlaiz/  美 /mə'tɪrɪəlaɪz/
v. 物化

imbibe
音标：英 /ɪm'baɪb/  美 /ɪm'baɪb/
v. 吸收
例句：She had imbibed the traditions of her family.
她受到了自己家庭传统的影响。

assimilate
音标：英 /ə'sɪmɪleɪt/  美 /ə'sɪməlet/
v. 吸收
例句：It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

sip
音标：英 /sɪp/  美 /sɪp/
v. 吸吮
短语：take a sip — 尝一口；小啜；喝一小口

allure
音标：英 /əˈlʊə(r)/  美 /əˈlʊr/
v. 吸引
例句：The allure and charm of Paris excite all who visit there.
巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。
例句：The allure and charm of Paris captivate all who visit there.
巴黎的诱惑与魅力吸引了所有到此游玩的人。

scrub
音标：英 /skrʌb/  美 /skrʌb/
v. 洗擦, 擦净, 使(气体)净化, 擦洗
短语：body scrub — 身体角质；身体磨砂膏
短语：scrub typhus — 恙虫病；洪水热
例句：She was on her hands and knees scrubbing the floor.
她正趴着擦地板。
例句：He scrubbed the dirt off his boots.
他把靴子上的脏土擦掉。
例句：The table needs to be scrubbed clean .
这桌子要擦干净。

peruse
音标：英 /pə'ruːz/  美 /pə'ruz/
v. 细读
例句：She leant forward to peruse the document more closely.
她俯身向前，更仔细地读那份文件。

perpend
音标：英 /'pɜːpend/  美 /pɚ'pɛnd/
v. 细细考虑

subside
音标：英 /səb'saɪd/  美 /səb'saɪd/
v. 下沉, 沉淀, 平息, 减退, 衰减
例句：After the heavy rains, part of the road subsided.
大雨过后，部分路面塌陷了。

preempt
音标：英 /prɪ'empt/  美 /,primpt/
v. 先占
例句：The law would preempt stronger local rules.
该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。
例句："the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
“适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

loiter
音标：英 /'lɒɪtə/  美 /'lɔɪtɚ/
v. 闲荡, 虚度, 徘徊
例句：Five or six teenagers were loitering in front of the newsagent’s.
五六个青少年在报摊前面游荡。

tattle
音标：英 /'tæt(ə)l/  美 /'tætl/
v. 闲谈
例句：Did you hear his frenzied tattle?
你听见这疯狂的闲谈了吗？
例句：But does tittle-tattle really help attract more friends?
但闲聊真的能吸引来更多的朋友吗？

comport
音标：英 /kəm'pɔːt/  美 /kəm'pɔ:t/
v. 相称
短语：comport with — 适合，一致
例句：His conduct did not comport with his high position.
他的所作所为与他的高级职务不相称。
例句：Milton claims that epic poetry is the highest ambition for a poet and then he goes on to explain how it is that the epic poet should comport himself.
弥尔顿声称史诗就是诗人最高的理想抱负,然后他又解释到,史诗诗人该怎样表现自己。

interplay
音标：英 /'ɪntəpleɪ/  美 /,ɪntɚ'plɛi/
v. 相互影响
例句：The answer lies, yet again, in the interplay of population and technology.
原因又一次在于人口和科技的相互影响。
例句：The tension and interplay between the situation and its negation, produce constantly new and emergent forms of social existence.
这些情形和其否定之间的张力和相互影响一直在产出崭新的和突现的社会存在形式。
例句：To date, most research into the interplay of exercise and anxiety has focused on the actions of various neurotransmitters or chemical messengers within the brain, like serotonin and dopamine.
迄今为止，大多数有关锻炼和焦虑的相互影响的研究都集中在大脑内的各种神经递质或化学信使，如血清素、多巴胺上。

descant
音标：英 /'deskænt/  美 /'dɛskænt/
v. 详论
例句：Sing a descant on a main tune or melody.
以主调或悦耳的音调唱着评论。

sift
音标：英 /sɪft/  美 /sɪft/
v. 详审
短语：sift through — 通过；被筛下
短语：sift out — 过筛
例句：Police are sifting through the evidence.
警方在筛查证据。

expound
音标：英 /ɪk'spaʊnd; ek-/  美 /ɪk'spaʊnd/
v. 详细说明, 解释
例句：Schmidt continued to expound his views on economics and politics.
施密特继续阐释他关于经济与政治的观点。

regale
音标：英 /rɪ'geɪl/  美 /rɪ'ɡel/
v. 享受
例句：Disclosure: This reporter also lives in New Haven and has heard Chua regale friends with parenting stories.
揭秘：记者也住在纽海文，曾经听过蔡在餐桌上分享育儿故事。
例句：Here you can still enjoy Chinese and Western buffet in the fresh morning, taste tea in the vernal afternoon and regale special beefsteak in the charming night.
在这里，您还可以在晨光中享用中西自助餐，在和熙的午后，品尝下午茶，在摇曳烛光中享用特色牛排。
